title: Constraints on Stable Scalar-Tensor Dark Energy from DESI Data and Solar System Tests
summary: We investigate the viability of scalar-tensor (quintessence) models of dark energy with a quartic polynomial nonminimal coupling to gravity and a linear scalar potential. The polynomial nonminimal coupling is used to ensure that the field is well stabilized in the early universe. We perform a systematic exploration of the parameter space spanned by the quadratic and quartic nonminimal couplings, as well as the slope of the potential.
